historical_set_transport.rule: X_{conj(psi)} = {conj(r) : r in X_psi} for C, FS1, D1(n), FS2, D2(n); conj(r)(a,b,c) = not r(not a, not b, not c)
historical_set_transport.note: 150 is self-dual, so its transport is the identity; 165 = conj(90) is absent from the thirteenth to fifteenth units and its historical sets are derived, while FS3_165 and D3_165(n) are computed directly as the covariance regression of O6
